content.comment_body: Hello, I am a new member. I have an issue involving a [product_name] module and an automation setup. My input I12 controls a relay and outdoor lamps, which are working. I13 is connected to my alarm system and is supposed to switch my bedroom window lamps when I am not home. The challenge is that when I return and I13 changes state, another output resets unexpectedly. The functionality I want is: If output Q6 is activated and I13 is deactivated, Q6 should remain on. Similarly, if Q6 is off, it should stay off. If anyone understands this, please help. //[user_name]
Hi [user_name], Try simulating the logic in emulation mode within [product_name]. You might need to adjust your switching conditions.
I tried but couldn’t find a solution. //[user_name]
Problem is solved, thanks for the help. I found a solution. //[user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: The user faced challenges setting up the desired logic for window lamp control with an alarm system input using [product_name] and KNX integration. The main issue was getting the output state to remain unchanged under specific conditions, highlighting difficulty with logical configuration or understanding how blocks work in the [product_name] environment. After trying different approaches, the problem was eventually resolved, though initial documentation and support were not sufficient for a quick fix.
analysis.user_expectations: User expects to configure logic in [product_name] easily so that a lamp output maintains its state when the input changes, without automatic resetting.
